availableGraphNamesJson.title: Available Graph Names Json
availableGraphNamesJson.description: Only set when fieldsJson is empty. The real graph names to choose from when graphCount > 1.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: If this org has more than one data graph and none/an invalid name was specified, lists the real available names here -- ask the user which one to use rather than guessing.

fieldsJson.title: Fields Json
fieldsJson.description: The full data graph definition (DMOs and fields) as JSON.

graphCount.title: Graph Count
graphCount.description: Only set when fieldsJson is empty. 0 = no data graphs exist in this org. >1 = ambiguous, see availableGraphNamesJson.

resolvedGraphApiName.title: Resolved Graph Api Name
resolvedGraphApiName.description: The actual data graph API name that was queried, whether auto-detected or explicitly passed.
